fact_english: Many sea cucumbers breathe by pumping water in and out through their rear end.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Maraming balatan, sea cucumber, ang humihinga sa pamamagitan ng pagbomba ng tubig sa kanilang puwitan.

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Hindi ko na itatanong kung paano nila nalaman.

why_here: After 'Pero huminto ang ulan.': what they see in the sky is the next line. Light episode: the silliest fact.
